name: Iliyanite
description:
You were born into the Iliyanite sect.

You cannot speak.

Once per rest for each rank you have in Spirit, you may spend an action to magically reshape a metal weapon or piece of armor within medium range. Choose one effect:

  • The item grants +1 Defense.

  • One of the item's damage dice increases or decreases by 1 die type.

  • One of the item's engagement dice increases or decreases by 1 die type.

The effect is magical and lasts for one hour, after which the item returns to its original form.

Describe how you shape metal.
